messages:
Maya: Quick design check — compact schema preview in playground run-history. Two patterns: Inline expansion inside the row vs open-in-modal. Need a decision for the next patch release.
Samir: Posted a quick prototype: https://figma.com/s/compact-schema-modal-proto. Notes: large example payloads make inline expansions jumpy; modal avoids layout shifts but adds context switch.
Eli: A11y baseline: both patterns need keyboard and screenreader flows. Inline: roving tabindex on rows, Enter toggles expansion, Escape collapses. Modal: focus must move into modal, return on close, and modal should be labelled and trap focus while open. Prefer modal for very large schemas.
Nora: Copy suggestion: label the affordance as "Preview params" not "View schema"  its friendlier. For modal header use the function name + "parameters". Also small CTA inside modal: "Copy example" and "Insert to prompt".
Priya: UX trade: inline is quicker for quick peeks and keeps you in flow; modal is better for deep inspection and editing examples. On small screens inline can be full-width expand; modal may feel heavy on phones. Suggest responsive rules: below 760px, use inline full-width; above that, modal is default for large payloads.
Maya: Accessibility nits: ensure reduced-motion respected for open/close animations; ensure aria-live updates for streaming structured keys; visible 4px focus ring for interactive elements. Inline expansion should set aria-hidden on sibling content when expanded to avoid screen reader noise.
Eli: Performance note: we should avoid fetching full payload until user requests expansion. Backend can provide a compactPreview in history list. Use client-side LRU cache for expanded results.
Samir: Engineering: will add compactPreview to /history API and a flag param expand=false by default. Also add a header when modal opens: X-Playground-Source:history to help telemetry.
Priya: Interaction detail: inline expansion should include a small header row with "Close" and a dedicated "Open in modal" button so user can escalate to modal without losing selection. Also include a small breadcrumb showing invocation id for traceability.
Maya: Microcopy swap: API/docs use "invocation" so UI should be consistent: change any "run" wording to "invocation". Also rename the history row component to InvocationItem in code.
ux-bot: design-token update: modal max-width 920px, modal padding 24px, compact preview height cap 72px.
Nora: Poll: reply INLINE or MODAL for default behavior on desktop. I'll tally and update the ticket.
Eli: INLINE (fewer clicks for quick debug)
Samir: MODAL (avoid layout jumps and allow richer tooling)
Priya: INLINE on desktop but modal for larger payloads (so hybrid)
Maya: Outcome: default to INLINE compact preview with an "Open in modal" escalation. Implement responsive fallback (inline full-width on <=760px). Eli: please add keyboard flows for both inline and modal in the prototype, and include aria-live phrasing for streaming updates. Samir: file the backend PR for compactPreview. Nora: I'll update copy doc and the a11y checklist (focus return, aria-hidden toggles, reduced-motion). Thanks!
